import sys,termios,json,hashlib,base64,gzip
a=termios.tcgetattr(0);a[3]&=~(termios.ECHO|termios.ICANON);termios.tcsetattr(0,termios.TCSANOW,a)
print("HULL_ARCHIVE_VERIFY_READY",flush=True)
envelope=json.loads(sys.stdin.readline());p=envelope["packet"]
packed=base64.b64decode(p["content"],validate=True)
assert len(packed)==p["gzipBytes"] and hashlib.sha256(packed).hexdigest()==p["gzipSha256"]
raw=gzip.decompress(packed);assert len(raw)==p["decodedBytes"]
packet=json.loads(raw);decoded={}
for name,entry in packet["files"].items():
 b=base64.b64decode(entry["content"],validate=True)
 assert len(b)==entry["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==entry["sha256"],name
 decoded[name]=b
for pin in envelope["candidatePins"]:
 b=decoded[pin["path"]]
 assert len(b)==pin["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==pin["sha256"],pin["path"]
 assert hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(b)).encode()+b"\0"+b).hexdigest()==pin["gitBlob"],pin["path"]
for name,expected in [("independent-browser.mjs",envelope["receiverBlob"]),("recipient-contract.json",envelope["recipientContractBlob"])]:
 b=decoded[name];assert hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(b)).encode()+b"\0"+b).hexdigest()==expected
receipt=json.loads(decoded["output/receipt.json"]);native=json.loads(decoded["native.json"])
assert receipt==packet["receipt"] and native==packet["native"]
assert native["exitCode"]==0 and native["timeout"] is False
assert receipt["status"]=="pass" and len(receipt["groups"])==15 and all(g["status"]=="pass" for g in receipt["groups"])
assert receipt["sourcePreserved"] and receipt["rawStreamsComplete"] and receipt["cleanupErrors"]==[]
assert receipt["childLifecycle"]["closed"] and receipt["childLifecycle"]["exitCode"]==0 and receipt["childLifecycle"]["signal"] is None
assert decoded["output/downloads/actual-convex-hull.json"]==decoded["courses/convex-hull.json"]
assert decoded["output/downloads/actual-convex-hull.md"]==decoded["courses/convex-hull.md"]
images=[{"path":n,"bytes":len(b),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()} for n,b in decoded.items() if n.startswith("output/screenshots/")]
assert len(images)==5 and all(decoded[i["path"]].startswith(b"\xff\xd8") and decoded[i["path"]].endswith(b"\xff\xd9") for i in images)
print(json.dumps({"schema":"recallweave-independent-hull-archive-integrity/1","status":"pass","canonicalEnvelopeBlob":"74f94cf5be44426ef77c8cb1fcb616605ac9bc3a","gzipSha256":p["gzipSha256"],"gzipBytes":len(packed),"decodedBytes":len(raw),"verifiedFiles":len(decoded),"verifiedOwnerPins":len(envelope["candidatePins"]),"receiverGitBlob":envelope["receiverBlob"],"nativeExit":native["exitCode"],"groups":len(receipt["groups"]),"sourcePreserved":True,"rawStreamsComplete":True,"exactLessonGuideDownloads":True,"images":images}),flush=True)
